item.title: Google’s Pixelsnap Chargers will get firmware updates
item.description: Just like other modern devices, the Pixelsnap Charger will see firmware updates, with the latest version of Pixel Stand revealing some details. more…

item.title: Google Drive regains full Material 3 Expressive redesign
item.description: Last year, Google Drive’s Material 3 Expressive redesign rolled out in a piecemeal fashion and saw one aspect revert. The full revamp with the container component is now available. more…

item.title: Motorola ‘Razr Fold’ is launching in 2026 with Pixel-like form factor, stylus support
item.description: After a few generations of clamshell foldables, Motorola is officially teasing the “Razr Fold” this year at CES, with the device launching later this year with stylus support as a major bullet point. more…

item.title: Moto Tag 2 brings improved Android Find Hub tracking and longer battery life
item.description: Motorola has announced a sequel to the Moto Tag, with the new Moto Tag 2 coming later this year with improved battery life and better tracking in the Android Find Hub app. more…

item.title: Motorola Signature is almost a razor-thin flagship for €999 [Gallery]
item.description: Motorola has a couple of new phones to show off at CES, and at least one of them lacks any kind of hinge. The new Motorola Signature looks like the company’s most promising non-Razr flagship in ages, but unfortunately, you might not get a chance to try it for yourself. more…

item.title: Lenovo unveils Snapdragon X2-powered Yoga PC alongside other new Windows laptops
item.description: Since Qualcomm expanded into developing Windows CPUs, Lenovo has offered a small number of laptops powered by the Snapdragon X Elite. With the Snapdragon X2 Elite and X2 Plus on the market, Lenovo is giving the Yoga PC series a needed update. more…

item.title: Motorola’s Razr Fold is incredibly promising, even though we don’t know everything yet [Gallery]
item.description: The Razr Fold doesn’t look like a company’s first steps in designing a larger foldable. In fact, the Razr Fold from Motorola meets the Galaxy Z Fold 7 and beats the Pixel 10 Pro Fold in almost every physical aspect, but it probably won’t be available for a good while. more…

item.title: Motorola still won’t revive the Moto 360, but new ‘Moto Watch’ copies Wear OS [Gallery]
item.description: Motorola took to CES 2026 with previews of some big announcements including its first book-style foldable, but also tagging along for the ride is a new “Moto Watch” that just can’t help but bring up memories of the Moto 360 that Motorola seemingly refuses to give a second chance. more…

item.title: The Clicks Communicator might not be for everyone, but it’s definitely for me
item.description: Clicks might have cut its teeth developing add-on keyboards for various smartphones — first iPhone, then Android — but its latest announcement appears to be its most promising yet. The Clicks Communicator feels like the first real minimalist device to potentially provide a substantial improvement over your daily driver, even if many of us might feel it’s better as a secondary device rather than a replacement for whatever you already own. more…
